10.2 Bibliography (Textbooks & Standards)

Methodological guidance for software life-cycle modeling, database normal forms, and requirements engineering was sourced from the following foundational academic treatises:

[1] Pressman, R. S., and Maxim, B. R. (2020). Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach, 9th Edition. New York: McGraw-Hill Education.
[2] Sommerville, I. (2016). Software Engineering, 10th Edition. Boston: Pearson Higher Education.
[3] Silberschatz, A., Korth, H. F., and Sudarshan, S. (2019). Database System Concepts, 7th Edition. New York: McGraw-Hill Education.
[4] IEEE Computer Society. (1998). IEEE Std 830-1998: IEEE Recommended Practice for Software Requirements Specifications. New York: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers.
